proposal.feasibility_note: Recommend 70° because it is the feasible setting with the largest physical effect (8% difference in the predicted observable) among settings that separate the models by ≥10σ. Expected separation 860.5σ RMS (max 1554σ) after the 0.5 s conditioning window. Larger values were avoided because above ~75° the string can go slack and the bob may leave the frame.
proposal.filming_instructions: Release the same pendulum from 70° (string taut, bob at rest), keep the camera and the reference object exactly where they were, and record at least 6 full swings.
